topic: Guard snapshot version 2 refuses calls until orchd restarts after brew upgrade
detail: From the RC-110 security review (low, fail closed): RC-110 bumped the guard snapshot to version 2. brew upgrade relinks orch-hook at once but does not restart orchd (the formula's caveat), so with a spaces policy applied and the guard enforcing, every tool call is refused as policy_unreadable until 'brew services restart orch'. Installs with no policy ever applied are allowed (the hook treats another version like a missing snapshot then). Documented in docs/internals/hooks.md. Proposed: name the version mismatch and the restart in the refusal reason, or restart orchd from the formula's post_install.
